concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-method-grant-node]] - limited-release Node.js Grant API route for giving another Braintree merchant controlled access to one customer payment method through a recipient access token and returned nonce
warnings: Keep the Grant API's current limited-release status and access-request requirement prominent; do not present the operation as generally available.
Preserve all participating identities: the granting merchant, another Braintree merchant as recipient, the granting merchant's customer, and one of that customer's payment methods.
Describe the scope as controlled access to the named payment method, not generic account/customer permission, ownership transfer, deletion, or revocation.

Treat allow_vaulting false and include_billing_postal_code true as displayed example values only; do not infer defaults or broader permission semantics, and do not treat the returned nonce as proof of payment success or settlement.
